note: Pocahontas County WV publishes no zoning districts. County commission attorney says zoning is not on the county agenda (pocahontastimes.com); residents oppose planning that could lead to zoning. Largest town, Marlinton, has a code of ordinances whose Title XV holds only Building Regulations, Comprehensive Plan and Floodplain chapters, no zoning districts or map. ArcGIS searches for Pocahontas zoning returned nothing; the county assessor's GIS offers parcels only, not zoning.
